title: Optim Finance Vaults - DeFi Building Blocks for Cardano

ms.promise: A GitHub repository of the smart contracts necessary to implement vault deposits, synthetic asset minting aka 'receipts’, and staking ‘locking’ mechanism. This is the modular architecture to function as a deposit “vault” for a flexible range of assets. The code will be produced using the Aiken programming language. This milestone entails the initial smart contract development of the core mint, receipt, stake for this product, finalized by freezing the GitHub repository and making it ready for the audit process
ms.criteria:
・Aiken codebase implementation of the Strategy Vault architecture

・Strategy flow of funds
・Deposit/Withdrawal mechanism
・Duration locking mechanism 
・Yield accrual logic 

・Video of code walkthrough to describe the smart contract components and working live interactions of a private testnet deployment for non-technical Milestone Reviewers and the broader Catalyst community to understand the scope of the system.
